content.description: First #NFT project on #Cardano that aims to help #women and #children association through charity with #pugs #dragons and #magic! Here is Pugs and Dragons, a funny, nerdy, philanthropical NFT series. We made 8000 randomly generated NFTs, 5 levels of scarcity, with up to 4 rare traits. A rare trait is usually golden or rainbow-coloured, but surprises have been hidden! As with a blister bag, you will have the surprise of your loot when you buy the NFT, maybe you'll get a Legendary one! Scarcity distribution Common: 59% of tokens. Magic: 20% of tokens.
